# MakingChips

> MakingChips is a comprehensive podcast network dedicated to manufacturing leadership, business education, and industry expertise across machine shops, fabrication, and industrial sectors.

The platform hosts 12+ specialized shows covering topics from financial management and HR leadership to automation, marketing, and cybersecurity compliance (CMMC). MakingChips serves manufacturing business owners, entrepreneurs, and executives with actionable insights and industry networking opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Manufacturing Leadership
- Machine Shop Management
- Business Strategy
- Manufacturing Entrepreneurship
- Podcast Network
- Business Education
- Manufacturing Industry
- Financial Management
- HR & Workplace Culture
- B2B Marketing
- Automation & Technology
- CMMC Certification
- Welding & Fabrication
- Industry Trends
- Manufacturing Recruitment

## Podcast Shows

- [MakingChips](https://makingchips.com/show/making-chips): Flagship podcast show for manufacturing business leadership content.
- [Machine Shop MBA](https://makingchips.com/show/machine-shop-mba): Focus on manufacturing entrepreneurship and shop management strategies.
- [Machine Shop Growth](https://makingchips.com/show/machine-shop-growth): Manufacturing business strategy and aerospace work opportunities.
- [Machine Shop Mastery](https://makingchips.com/show/machine-shop-mastery): CMMC certification and industry leadership with Paul Van Metre.
- [Buy the Numbers](https://makingchips.com/show/buy-the-numbers): Financial management and business strategy for manufacturers.
- [The Manufacturing Executive](https://makingchips.com/show/manufacturing-executive): Interviews on business strategy and industry trends for executives.
- [The Manufacturing Employer](https://makingchips.com/show/manufacturing-employer): HR leadership and workplace culture in manufacturing organizations.
- [The Manufacturing Marketer](https://makingchips.com/show/manufacturing-marketer): B2B marketing strategy and tactics for manufacturers.
- [At The Boring Bar](https://makingchips.com/show/at-the-boring-bar): Roundtable discussions featuring manufacturing leadership insights.
- [MakingSparks](https://makingchips.com/show/making-sparks): Welding, fabrication, and blacksmithing industry education.
- [Lights Out](https://makingchips.com/show/lights-out): Automation and manufacturing technology innovation.
